text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 2.8–3.2% over 24 hours, signaling a modest pullback after a period of strength. Fear & Greed remains elevated at 71 with a sharp 20-point climb over the week, indicating retail confidence persists despite the dip. Bitcoin dominance at 58.8% and solid $132B daily volume suggest the market is consolidating rather than panicking, with capital rotating rather than fleeing.
